title: The intrinsic cardiac nervous system is essential for cardiac function and survival.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Found GEO series GSE330884 (same title) via NCBI search; read its series text and FTP file list: 3 samples, each a 10x Genomics barcodes/features/matrix.mtx triplet (131 MB tar total). Downloaded the 3 barcode files: 2,829 + 2,256 + 3,276 = 8,361 cell barcodes. No cell-type annotation, metadata or cluster file is deposited.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500 twice and the supplement endpoint returned no zip. Claims about two neuron subtypes (Npy+ and Ddah1+), ablation, and stress-induced arrhythmia come from the abstract; the physiology/imaging data does not appear to be deposited anywhere I found.

a1_downloadable.note: GEO GSE330884 open download, 3 raw count matrices; checked file list and barcodes.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked files: only unannotated count matrices. Any label (neuron subtype) would have to be constructed by clustering the cells ourselves; the physiological outcomes (survival, heart rate, arrhythmia) are not deposited.

a3_inputs_present.note: Gene-by-cell count matrices present (features.tsv with gene IDs).

a4_units_stated.note: Raw UMI (unique molecular identifier) counts, standard 10x format.

a5_enough_rows.note: 8,361 barcodes counted across 3 samples, before quality filtering; but no labels.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Small sparse matrices; trivially fits in 16 GB RAM.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No full text available to compare cell counts; GEO lists 3 samples consistent with its design text (anterior, posterior, mixed).

a8_label_provenance.note: Subtype labels would come from clustering the same expression features, so predicting them from expression is circular by construction.

backbone.name: scGPT or Geneformer (single-cell foundation models) would apply in principle

integration.partner_dataset: Mouse cardiac / peripheral neuron atlases, e.g. GSE322764 'Lineage and Organ Signals Sequentially Build Organ Intrinsic Nervous Systems' scRNA-seq (found in GEO search, not opened)
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Whether intrinsic cardiac neuron subtypes map onto shared organ-intrinsic neuron types across organs, but this is a descriptive atlas comparison, not a labelled prediction task.

controls.positive_control: Npy and Ddah1 marker separation (from abstract) would be the obvious sanity check if clustering were done.
controls.negative_control: Label shuffling; not meaningful without a measured label.

honest_claim_h3: With only 8,361 unlabelled mouse cardiac neurons, a model could at most reproduce clusters we defined from the same expression data, which claims nothing new.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use single-cell gene expression of mouse heart neurons to predict which of two neuron subtypes each cell belongs to.
plain_idea.train_on: Gene expression counts for each of about 8,361 sorted mouse heart neuron cells (counted from the deposited barcode files, before quality filtering).
plain_idea.predict: Neuron subtype (Npy-positive vs Ddah1-positive); no measured label exists, it would come from our own clustering of the same data.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little: subtype calls from marker genes are already trivial, and the interesting physiology outcomes (survival, arrhythmia) were not released.

ml_idea: None viable: deposited data is three unannotated single-cell count matrices; the physiology outcomes that would make a prediction target are not public.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from file sizes on GEO; nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Look for a deposited cell-annotation table (none on GEO) — already failed.

verdict_reason: A2/A8 fail: GEO GSE330884 holds only 8,361 unannotated mouse heart-neuron single-cell profiles; subtype labels would be self-made clusters from the same features, and the physiology outcomes aren't deposited.
